question: Where on tile 4342-29-60 does the gen1 return shape carry the Elba-fitted fingerprint of the standing herbaceous sward?

inputs.role: the fitted LDA: feature names, standardisation mean/std, coef, intercept; fitted by fingerprint_fit.py
Clubb (lsdtt-valley-metrics) floodplain mask, USED AS THE DOMAIN because it is present
gen1 CSF ground returns: cell, d_mm_corr (mm above the slope-normal gen2 surface, corrected), in_grid

params.name: model_training
params.value: 'data/derived/elbaext_delong_star_nosurf; n 12135; AUC CV 0.708, resub 0.810; git a9c80110beae'

masks.name: domain
masks.defn: floodplain & slope <= 2 deg (return_shape.py's flat, minus its finite-DoD and gen2-open conditions, which need files this tile need not have)

columns.lo_w: p50 - p10 of the pooled gen1 return heights, mm (lower width)
columns.bowley: (p75 + p25 - 2 p50) / max(p75 - p25, 20 mm) (Bowley skew, dimensionless)
columns.peak: share of pooled returns within +/-50 mm of the mode
columns.tail_L: mean of (h - mode - 100 mm) over returns above mode + 100 mm (e-folding length of the upper tail), mm
columns.tail_mass: share of pooled returns above mode + 100 mm
columns.low_mass: share of pooled returns below mode - 100 mm
columns.score: LDA decision function on the standardised shape features, dimensionless; > 0 leans towards the imagery class
columns.p: 1 / (1 + exp(-score)), the LDA's class-1 posterior under its fitted priors (dimensionless)
columns.what: row label of the summary quantity
columns.value: the summary quantity, count or dimensionless score as the row label says

headline: 9105 cells scored; 48 with p > 0.5
